posts.author: volume
posts.title: The misuse of weapons.
posts.html:
I don't know if this is a bad or a good idea so feel free to comment.
My idea is to have new people wait a certain period before they can use weapons.
Say, you have to have played 10 hours on the server before you can use weapons.
This way new people will not have access to guns and start their rampages.
As i said, this is a just an idea.
